svg.title: One band, two legal SIXEL paint orders
svg.desc: The same eight by six four-color indexed band is encoded by Netpbm ppmtosixel as six row streams totaling 135 paint and control bytes, and by img2sixel fast as four six-bit color planes totaling 25 bytes. Palette definitions, envelopes, and Netpbm formatting line feeds are omitted.
svg.text: One band, two legal SIXEL paint orders
Netpbm emits one source row at a time; img2sixel -E fast packs six rows into color-plane masks.
The img2sixel run uses the same register order as ppmtosixel.
Palette definitions, DCS/ST, and ppmtosixel's formatting LF bytes are outside the comparison.
Netpbm ppmtosixel: scan six source rows
Each row chooses one single-bit character; only adjacent same-color pixels are repeated.
img2sixel -E fast: scan four color planes
Each color plane contributes six-bit columns; node scheduling joins non-overlapping spans.
six row streams, six $ returns, final -
Same indexed layout; the comparison isolates paint/control bytes, not palette construction or color rounding.
